people.imagined: A dusty road camp at dusk. He sits by a dead fire chewing the cold pipe, riding behind someone he has followed for twenty years. He has just refused a hire; the pipe has not moved.
people.subject: The moment: seated on a saddle blanket at a road camp at dusk, he looks up slowly at the viewer, jaw working on a cold pipe. Face: most important, the pipe and the dust: an unlit brown wooden pipe with a chewed bone stem clamped in his teeth at the right corner, and pale road dust packed into every crease of his face so the lines show as pale grooves. A long, hard, weathered face; deep-set grey-brown eyes narrowed; short grey-flecked black brows; a hooked nose; a short stubble; thin lips around the stem. Hair: black with grey at the temples, short and dust-pale, with a strip of grey cloth tied round the forehead. Body: lean, broad-shouldered, hunched forward with forearms on his knees. Clothing: a fine undyed grey cloth robe, the left sleeve long and hanging past the hand, belted with a plain black belt; the cloth dust-pale at the shoulders; a short leather riding jerkin over it. Hands and objects: the long left sleeve hangs over his knee; his right hand rests on the hilt of a plain straight sword laid across his lap. Background: a flat dry plain, a low red sun, a smoke thread from a cold fire. Light: low orange sunset from the upper left, long shadows. Expression: reserved, loyal, quietly stubborn. A faint grey-gold hint of metal qi with a warm red thread.

people.imagined: The contract house's counting table. She counts the sleeve prices and brings out her smile only to count; the abacus at her belt clicks. She was bought out of a camel debt at fourteen.
people.subject: The moment: at a counting table she smiles brightly while pressing the beads of a small iron abacus, the smile fading as she looks up. Face: most important, the smile: a bright, wide, practised smile showing teeth, placed on a face that is otherwise flat and cold, with the eyes not joining in. A small, round, sallow face; narrow, black, calculating eyes; thin arched brows; a small straight nose; a mole at the corner of her mouth. Her skin is a little sallow and fine lines bracket her mouth. Hair: black, severely parted in the middle and tied in a flat bun at the nape with a grey cord. Body: small, upright, hands busy. Clothing: a fine undyed grey cloth robe, the left sleeve long but neatly folded back at the wrist and pinned (her working sleeve); a narrow grey belt; an iron abacus hanging at the belt on a chain. Hands and objects: the small iron abacus with black beads under her thumb; a small leather purse; a stack of flat copper coins in neat columns on the table. Her thumb is pale and square-nailed and the abacus beads are polished dark by use. Background: a plain grey office, a window with desert light. Light: pale flat light from the upper left. Expression: a bright, practised smile laid over a flat, cold face, the narrow eyes not joining in, a cautious woman who smiles only to count; a faint grey-gold hint of metal qi.

people.imagined: The valley hall door at night. He holds the lamp while the head opens the founder's robe for another; every time the wind rattles the door he stares at the ceiling, jaw tight.
people.subject: The moment: in a dim doorway he holds up a small lamp, his eyes rolled up to the ceiling as the wind rattles the door. Face: most important, the soot thumbprint and the upward stare: a dark soot thumbprint smudged on the left sleeve at the front of the frame, and eyes fixed on the rafters with the whites showing. A square, plain, young face; thick dark brows drawn down; a heavy jaw clenched; narrow dark eyes; a short nose; a mouth set hard with resentment. A line of sweat shines at the hairline and a nick runs through one eyebrow. Hair: black, cropped short and bristly, a cloth band round the forehead. Body: stocky, broad, planted. Clothing: an undyed grey cloth short-sleeved jacket of an outer disciple, both sleeves short, clean and pressed but soot-marked at the left cuff; a grey belt; dark trousers; felt boots. Hands and objects: an oil lamp with a small yellow flame held up in his right hand; a miner's pick-scar on the left hand. The lamp's brass bowl is dull with fingerprints, and its flame stands upright in the draught. Background: a dark wooden door shaking on its hinges, a bar of cold light under it. Light: warm lamplight from the right, cold blue from the doorway. Expression: a clenched, resentful, loyal glare at the rafters, the jaw tight and the whites of the eyes showing; a faint earth-brown hint of earth qi.

people.imagined: A hot steppe road after her first sealed contract. She wants the next long hire, whatever the contract house says. Dust red on her boots; two tight braids; she faces the sun squarely.
people.subject: The moment: standing on a hot red-dust road, hands on hips, chin up, she looks the viewer straight in the eye. Face: most important, the two braids and the red dust: two tight braids standing out from her head on each side, and a stripe of red dust across her boots and shins at the frame's lower edge. A narrow, tanned, bright face; slightly flared nostrils; keen, dark, hot eyes; thick straight brows; a wide mouth in a tight proud smile. Sweat shines at her temples and a fine layer of red dust powders her cheeks. Hair: black, in two tight braids to her shoulders tied with brown cord. Body: lithe, strong shoulders, upright. Clothing: an undyed grey cloth jacket with short sleeves, the outer-gate cut, fitted and clean; a narrow belt of red-brown leather; short trousers and leggings to the knee; a plain red-brown scarf at her neck. Hands and objects: a plain sword in its scabbard at her left hip, her right hand on her hip. Background: a flat red steppe road, a heat haze, a bright sky. A single dry thorn tree stands at the roadside and a pale cloud mark floats on the far edge of the sky. Light: hard bright noon light from the upper left. Expression: a proud, impatient, brave half-smile, the hot dark eyes steady on the viewer, a young woman who wants the next long hire; a faint hot red hint of fire qi.

people.imagined: The pass in autumn with a mule load of ore, more than anyone asked for, because a polisher at the forge will take it. He waits for a joke to be explained a second time.
people.subject: The moment: standing by a laden mule on a mountain track, he is mid-grin, one hand pulling a rag from his pocket as if to polish something. Face: most important, the hands and the rag: both fists ground black with ore dust in every knuckle crease, and a white polishing rag, not his own, half pulled from his pocket. A broad, open, honest face with a round chin; wide-set kind brown eyes; thick, slightly crooked brows; a snub nose; a big, uncertain grin. Hair: black, in a short untidy tail. Body: stocky and strong, a little clumsy. He stands with his big hands hanging, his shoulders rounded from carrying, one foot turned slightly in. Clothing: a fine undyed grey cloth robe, left sleeve long but rolled back for work, ore-dust at the hem; a rope belt; a leather shoulder-strap of the mule load; boots. Hands and objects: ore-black hands, a white rag, a canvas sack of dull grey ore on his back. The mule behind him wears two heavy panniers tied with red cord, and the rag in his pocket is cleaner than anything else on him, white as milk. Background: a stony autumn track, orange birches, a mule with panniers. Light: warm low autumn light from the upper left. A pale autumn sun lights the orange leaves behind and warms the ore dust on his knuckles. Expression: trusting, hopeful, a bit puzzled. A faint grey-gold hint of metal qi.

people.imagined: The contract house's desk. She presses the Seal on what she is handed and asks nothing; not a hair out of place, a brass stud on a cord, waiting for someone else's desk.
people.subject: The moment: at a desk she presses a hand-sized bronze seal onto a paper with an even, steady arm, looking up under her brows at the viewer. Face: most important, the brass stud on its cord: a bright brass stud the size of a coin hung on a cord round her neck, shining, and her hair absolutely perfect. A sleek, oval, pale face; cold, dark, almond eyes; thin, perfectly arched brows; a small, thin nose; thin, red-painted lips in a narrow smile. Her cheeks are powdered to a flawless pallor. Hair: jet black, glossy, in a perfect high knot with every strand smoothed, held by a grey pin. Body: slim, very upright, sleeves immaculate. Clothing: a fine undyed grey robe with the long left sleeve folded and pinned at the elbow with a small grey button; a narrow belt of grey silk; a plain collar buttoned. Hands and objects: the bronze seal (marked with only a plain sleeve-and-sword emblem) pressed down; a sheet of paper (blank). A pot of red paste stands open beside the seal, a small dab of it on her fingertip. Background: a bare desk, a screen, a window with desert light. Light: cool flat light from the upper left. Expression: a cold, watchful, narrow-eyed composure, the red lips just curved, an ambitious woman who stamps what she is handed and asks nothing; a faint grey-gold hint of metal qi.

people.imagined: The hall of sleeves at first light. She sweeps with a broom worn to a stump, and her eyes go to every visitor's sleeve. The newest sleeve on the beam is her brother's.
people.subject: The moment: in a high hall hung with rows of grey sleeves she stops sweeping and stares at the viewer's sleeve. Face: most important, the stump broom: a straw broom worn down to a short stub, gripped in both hands at her chest, and the rows of limp grey sleeves hanging on beams behind her. A thin, solemn, pale face; large, dark, searching eyes; thin straight brows; a small nose; a small, tight, grieving mouth. Hair: black, in a long single braid pinned up under a grey kerchief. Body: slight, narrow, upright. Her thin shoulders are pulled up and her back is stiff, as if standing at attention. Clothing: an undyed grey cloth jacket with short sleeves (outer disciple), clean and pressed; a grey apron; a narrow belt; trousers; felt shoes. Hands and objects: the stub broom held upright. The broom's straw is worn to a short brown brush less than a hand long, bound tight with red thread; the nearest sleeve on the beam is pale grey with a single dark stain at the cuff. Background: dim wooden beams hung with dozens of faded grey sleeves in rows, dust in a ray of light. Light: a pale ray from a high window at the upper left. Dust hangs in the ray of light beside her, in lazy gold specks. Expression: devout, patient, grieving. A faint grey hint of metal qi.

people.imagined: The keeper of contracts reading a client's hands before the client's letter. Ink on two fingers; she turns the hand palm up and says the price.
people.subject: The moment: seated at a desk she holds out her own ink-stained hand and looks at the viewer's hands as if reading them, a pleasant smile on her face. Face: most important, the ink on two fingers: the forefinger and middle finger of her right hand stained black to the second knuckle, held up in the foreground. A neat, handsome, oval face; warm, sharp, dark brown eyes; a high smooth forehead; arched brows; a straight nose; a pleasant, wide, controlled smile; light lines at the corners of the eyes. Hair: black with a streak of grey at the left temple, wound in a neat bun with a simple wooden pin. Body: slim, upright, easy. Clothing: a fine undyed grey cloth coat, well cut, with the left sleeve long and folded back at the wrist; a plain grey inner robe; a narrow dark belt; a small bronze seal on a cord at the neck. Hands and objects: the ink-stained hand; on the desk a bound book and a plain sword with a wire-wrapped hilt. Background: a bright, tidy contract office, a paper screen. Light: warm pale light from the upper left. Expression: ambitious, genial, shrewd. A faint grey-gold hint of metal qi with a warm earth tone.

people.imagined: Home after twenty years of caravans. Road-burnt dark, a scar that makes her mouth smile where she does not mean to. She looks at the valley as at a place she has paid for.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a doorway, home from the road, she looks at the viewer with a stare that does not match her mouth. Face: most important, the scar smile: a pale scar runs from the left corner of her mouth up toward the cheekbone, pulling that corner into a permanent crooked half-smile while her eyes stay hard and flat. A long, square-jawed face burnt dark brown by the sun; narrow, grey, unsmiling eyes; straight heavy brows; a strong nose; a wide mouth. Dust lies in the lines at her eyes and the scar shines slightly in the light. Hair: black, cut to the jaw and wind-roughed, with a strip of faded red cloth round the head. Body: tall, rangy, broad-shouldered, standing wide. Clothing: a fine undyed grey cloth robe with the left sleeve long, trail-stained but clean at the cuff; a leather jerkin with a brass buckle; a dark scarf at the neck; a belt with a plain sword. Hands and objects: her right hand resting on the sword's hilt, scarred across the knuckles. Her fingers are broad, calloused and brown, with a pale seam across one knuckle. Background: a doorway of a grey stone hall with a hot dusty courtyard beyond. Light: hard noon light from the upper left, deep shadow beneath her brow. Expression: a hard, honest, wrathful stare that does not match the crooked smile, a woman looking at the valley as at a place she has paid for; a strong warm red hint of fire qi.

people.imagined: The mouth of the Can Tương mine. A square slow man leans on his sword as on a walking stick and points with it at the vein. He trusts the smiths and he trusts the ring of their blades.
people.subject: The moment: standing at a mine mouth he uses the point of a plain sword to indicate a vein of grey ore in the wall, looking at the viewer to be sure they follow. Face: most important, the sword as pointer: a plain straight sword held pointing, its point resting on a streak of bright grey ore, the blade's hilt wrapped in grey cord. A square, solid, slow face with a heavy brow; calm, small, brown eyes; thick brown brows; a wide, flat nose; a patient mouth; a grey-black short beard. Grey dust has settled in his beard and into the lines of his brow. Hair: grey-black, short and bristly, a grey cloth tied round the forehead. Body: square, thick, broad, immovable. Clothing: a fine undyed grey cloth robe, the left sleeve long and tied back with a strip of leather, ore-dust at the cuffs; a leather apron; heavy miner's boots; a short lamp on a belt. Hands and objects: the sword; a lump of grey ore with silver glints in the left hand. The sword's blade is bright and dark-edged and the cord on the grip is clean. Background: the dark mouth of a mine with timber props and a rail. Light: warm lamp-yellow from the right, grey from the upper left. Expression: a patient, stubborn, loyal steadiness with calm eyes, a slow man making sure you follow; a faint grey-gold hint of metal qi.

people.imagined: The outer gate's yard. Chalk to his elbows, he draws a footwork pattern on the flagstones and speaks without raising his voice. He has never been hired out.
people.subject: The moment: in a yard he kneels beside a flagstone drawing a footwork pattern in chalk, looking up at the viewer. Face: most important, the chalk: white chalk dust coating both forearms to the elbows and the sleeves of his robe, and a stick of chalk in his fingers. A long, gentle, deeply lined face; steady pale-brown eyes; long white-streaked brows; a long straight nose; a calm, closed mouth; a grey moustache and small beard. Hair: grey, tied in a neat topknot with a grey cloth. Body: tall, thin, slightly stooped, patient. He kneels on one knee with his long back bent, his shoulders narrow and his head lowered a little forward. Clothing: a fine undyed grey cloth robe, left sleeve long and tucked into the belt, the cloth chalk-dusted at the knees and forearms; a rope belt; felt shoes. Hands and objects: the chalk in his right hand; the left hand resting on his knee. The chalk pattern is a row of footprints joined by arrows, with a circle at its centre, all in plain lines; chalk powder lies in a white fan on the stones around his knee. Background: a flagstone yard with chalk lines, a low wall, a young row of short-sleeved disciples blurred behind. Light: soft pale light from the upper left. The pale light shows the grain of the chalk on his sleeves, like fine frost. Expression: patient, content, just. A faint grey-gold hint of metal qi.

people.imagined: The hall of the founder's robe, after the fold. The head has opened it for him with his own Wind and the boy's nose bleeds. He turns his head toward every draught.
people.subject: The moment: in a dim hall a boy stands with his head turned sharply toward a draught, a line of red under his nose. Face: most important, the red crust: a thick line of dried and fresh red blood under the left nostril, smeared to the lip, clearly visible. A thin, quick, boyish face; wide, bright, pale-brown eyes with a faint silvery shine; thin brows; a narrow nose; a half-open mouth; hollow cheeks. Hair: dark, brown-black, messy, standing on end as if from wind. Body: slight, quick, shoulders high. His shoulders are narrow, his arms thin, and his fingers on the open hand slightly spread. Clothing: an undyed grey cloth jacket with the long left sleeve of an inner disciple, clean; a plain belt; trousers; boots. Hands and objects: one hand held open at his side, palm up, as if feeling the air; a rolled cloth at his waist. A thread of dust lifts in a slow spiral by his open palm, and the red crust under his nostril has a fresh bright drop at the centre. Background: a dim hall with a faint pale draught lifting dust, a hint of a hung grey robe in shadow. Light: cool light from the upper left, a bright thin gleam. The ray of light shows tiny specks of dust moving sideways, all in the same direction. Expression: fickle, brave, alert. A faint pale-silver hint of wind qi lifting his hair.

people.imagined: Her room, a half-packed kit under the bed. She has asked for the Desert Road every month and put her own name on the list behind her master's back. She holds a scabbard that has never been scuffed.
people.subject: The moment: sitting on a bunk edge she holds a scabbard across her knees, polishing it with a thumb, looking up in challenge at the viewer. Face: most important, the unscuffed scabbard: a black lacquered scabbard that is perfectly smooth, bright and unmarked, with a thin brass fitting, in the foreground, and a half-packed kit visible at the frame edge. A sharp, handsome, tanned face; hard, bright, hazel eyes; straight, thick brows; a straight nose; a thin set mouth. Hair: black, in a high tight tail with a grey cord. Body: lean, trim, restless. She sits upright on the very edge of the bunk with her knees apart, ready to stand. Clothing: a fine undyed grey cloth robe with the left sleeve long and folded back; a fitted dark jerkin; a narrow belt; leggings. Hands and objects: the black scabbard; below, an open bag with rolled blankets and a water flask. The scabbard is black lacquer with a single band of brass at the mouth and one at the tip, with no scratch or dent; the bag beneath the bunk shows a coiled rope, three flat cakes in cloth and a clay water flask. Background: a plain bunk room, a window of bright light. Light: bright pale light from the upper left. The window light makes the lacquer shine like a black mirror, with a long white reflection down its length. Expression: faithless, wrathful, eager. A faint red-orange and grey-gold hint of fire and metal.

people.imagined: The copying desk. Ink in the grain of her nails; a cloth for every blot. She has written a camel train that nobody's seen into the road book and watches the viewer to see if they will check.
people.subject: The moment: at a copying desk she wipes a blot with a cloth, eyes lifting warily. Face: most important, the nails: all ten fingernails and the skin around them stained black with ink, held in the foreground, with a white cloth in the right hand. A neat, small, pale face; large dark watchful eyes; thin brows; a small straight nose; a small mouth tight with caution. Hair: black, in a smooth bun with two plain pins. Body: slight, careful, narrow shoulders. She sits close to the desk with her shoulders hunched and her elbows tucked in, ready to hide her page. Clothing: an undyed grey cloth short-sleeved jacket of the outer gate, clean; a grey cloth apron with ink spots; a narrow belt; paper-thin cuffs. Hands and objects: a brush in the left hand; a clean cloth in the right; a bound book open, blank. The brush is thin as a reed with a worn tip, and the cloth is folded in neat quarters; beside the book a lamp with a green glass shade burns low. Background: a small desk with a lamp and rolls of paper, a window of desert light. Light: soft light from the upper left, warm from the lamp. The soft light lies flat on the desk and shows every ink-black line in her nails. Expression: cautious, greedy, secret. A faint grey-gold hint of metal.

people.imagined: The pasture road. Two rough-coated dogs at his heels, he understands the saying on the lintel better than the rest. He is sunburnt to the neck and says nothing.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a pasture with two dogs sitting at his heels, he looks gently at the viewer. Face: most important, the dogs: two rough-coated tan-and-grey shepherd dogs, one on each side of his knees, panting, heads up, their ears pricked, big in the frame. A long, calm, sunburnt face, red to the collar and pale above the hat line; patient pale-blue eyes; faint light brows; a long nose; a quiet mouth. Hair: sandy-brown, short, under a flat grey felt cap. Body: lean, lanky, relaxed. He stands with his feet apart and his shoulders loose, his long neck sunburnt to red. Clothing: an undyed grey cloth jacket with short sleeves (outer gate), plain; a shepherd's staff-strap across the chest; rough trousers; boots. Hands and objects: a crook-headed wooden staff in his right hand; his left hand dropped to a dog's head. The left dog has a grey muzzle and a white blaze on the chest, the right one a brown patch over one eye; a leather leash lies coiled and unused over his shoulder. Background: wide dry grassland and a white sky, small distant sheep. Light: bright clear light from the upper left. The bright light makes the dust on the dogs' coats shine like gold. Expression: calm, reclusive, patient. A faint earth-yellow hint of earth qi.

people.imagined: A mine gallery in the dark. His lamp is the one that goes out. A cough, a scar on the forehead where the lamp hit him, and he is not unhappy.
people.subject: The moment: in a dark mine gallery he holds a dead lamp up and peers at it, coughing into his fist. Face: most important, the scar: a raised, shiny, round lamp-scar the size of a coin in the middle of the forehead, pink against the grey-dusted skin, and the cough. A young, round, dusty face; pale eyes; thin light brows; a snub nose; a loose, content mouth. Hair: brown, matted with grey dust, short. Body: slouched, broad, a little round. He stands with his back to a timber prop, shoulders sagging, belly soft under the jacket. Clothing: an undyed grey cloth jacket with short sleeves, dust-grey; a cloth cap; a rope belt; trousers. Hands and objects: a small miner's oil lamp with no flame in his left hand; his right fist at his mouth. The dead lamp has a cracked glass and a dried wick; his fist at his mouth has a thin line of grey dust on each knuckle. Background: a black gallery with timber props, a faint light far behind. Light: only a pale grey glow from the upper left, deep dark around. A single thin pale beam finds the round scar on his forehead like a coin. Expression: content, trusting, lazy. A faint earth-brown hint of earth qi.

people.imagined: 560, settling in the grassland valley under the Pivot. A memorial portrait of the lean wandering swordsman with a hawk's pinion in his hair, never seen to hurry, who cut a saying on a lintel.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened; a lean swordsman stands in grass wind, calm. Face: most important, the pinion: a long brown hawk's feather tucked through his topknot, rising at an angle behind his head, big and clear. A long, lean, calm, wind-weathered face; narrow, steady, dark eyes; thin dark brows; a straight nose; a thin, closed, patient mouth; a short grey-black beard. Hair: black, in a topknot with the feather. Body: lean, tall, relaxed, one hip cocked. His shoulders are narrow, his arms long and loose, and his weight rests on one leg, quite unhurried. Clothing: a plain grey cloth robe with a single long left sleeve hanging past the hand, the cloth worn but clean; a narrow belt; leggings. Hands and objects: a plain sword in its scabbard in the right hand, point down; the long left sleeve lifting in the wind. The sword has a plain wooden grip wrapped with undyed cord and a worn scabbard; the hawk's pinion in his hair is brown with a pale bar near the tip. Background: a pale, mottled, aged-silk ground with faint grass and a low mountain. Light: soft pale light from the upper left, dark vignette. A faint wind-lift moves the grass at his feet and the long sleeve, like a slow wave. Expression: calm, unhurried, aloof. A faint pale-silver hint of wind qi, softened by the fade.

people.imagined: The second head, 790-1090. A memorial portrait of the short brisk woman who had no Wind and built the valley a living: the seal cord round her neck and a ledger under her arm.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened; a short brisk woman standing, ledger under her arm. Face: most important, the seal cord and the ledger: a thick cord round her neck carrying a bronze seal on her chest, and a thick book bound in cord clamped under her left arm. A round, compact, shrewd face; bright small eyes; neat straight brows; a short nose; a firm, brisk, small mouth; a double line between the brows. A few fine lines mark her brow and the outer corners of her eyes. Hair: black with grey, in a tight bun with a plain pin. Body: short, sturdy, upright, quick. Clothing: a plain grey cloth robe, the left sleeve long but tied back with a cord for work; a belt with a small iron abacus; a collar buttoned. Hands and objects: the right hand on the seal; the left arm pressing the book. Background: a pale, mottled, aged-silk ground with faint rows of sleeves on a beam. Light: soft light from the upper left, dark vignette. The faded silk tone turns the grey cloth a pale warm putty and leaves a gold glint only on the seal. Expression: a brisk, patient, pragmatic firmness, the small mouth set and the eyes quick, a woman who built the valley a living; a faint grey-gold hint of metal qi, softened by the fade.
